body:
PLAN REVIEW — journal model + cadence in /picode-models selector

Reviewed all 6 files. Plan sound. Refined below with corrections + missed risks.

## Verdict: Change 1 + 2 approved as-is. Change 3: do 3b (selector UI). One missed risk in compaction path.

## Change 1: Add 'journal' to selector — APPROVED
- `src/commands-models.ts:22` ROLE_DISPLAY_ORDER — insert `"journal"` after `"default"`, before `"builder"`. Journal is config-adjacent to default, not a worker role.
- NOT in NON_ROLE_KEYS (line 30) — correct, must be visible/writable.
- `buildRoleItems` (line 76) auto-shows description = `config["journal"] ?? "(not set)"`. Want custom: "(inherits coordinator model)" when unset. Add special-case in `addRole`:
  ```ts
  if (role === "journal" && !model) { items.push({value:role, label:role, description:"(inherits coordinator model)"}); return; }
  ```
- `spawn.ts:resolveModel` (line 67) only looks up actual role arg — ignores "journal" key. Safe. No change.
- Reset-all (line 232) preserves only NON_ROLE_KEYS → clears "journal". Correct semantic (reset = inherit).
- Clear on journal role = delete key → inherits coordinator. Correct.
- Text fallback `commands.ts:345` filters `k !== "theme"` only → "journal" shows. Fine, but label "journal: deepseek/..." may confuse. Acceptable — minor.

## Change 2: Read models.json 'journal' in state.ts — APPROVED WITH FIX
- `src/state.ts:357-359` forkJournal AND `:362-365` compactJournal both read CLI flag only. **Both must change** — plan mentioned compaction at state.ts:364 in edge cases but Change 2 text only said "src/state.ts:358". Apply to BOTH.
- Need models.json read. `spawn.ts:loadModelsJson` is module-private + cached by mtime. Two options:
  - **(A) Export `loadModelsJson` from spawn.ts, import in state.ts.** Reuses cache. Cleanest. DRY.
  - **(B) Inline read in state.ts.** Duplicates path resolution + parse. Worse.
- Recommend A. Add `export` to `loadModelsJson` in spawn.ts. Then:
  ```ts
  forkJournal(sessionFile: string) {
    const flag = pi.getFlag("picode-journal-model");
    const m = (typeof flag === "string" && flag) || loadModelsJson()["journal"] || undefined;
    forkJournalEntry(store, sessionFile, m);
  },
  compactJournal(sessionFile: string) {
    if (!store.sessionFile) return;
    const flag = pi.getFlag("picode-journal-model");
    const m = (typeof flag === "string" && flag) || loadModelsJson()["journal"] || undefined;
    compactJournalFn(store, sessionFile, m);
  },
  ```
- Priority: CLI flag → models.json → undefined (inherit). Matches plan. Backward compat preserved.

## Change 3: Cadence — DO 3b (selector UI), not 3a
- 3a (CLI flag only): not persistent per-project. User has to re-pass `--picode-journal done` every session. Defeats purpose.
- 3b: store `"journal-cadence"` in models.json. Modify `journalMode()` (src/journal.ts:78) to read models.json as fallback after CLI flag.
- **Problem:** `journalMode(pi)` signature takes only `pi: ExtensionAPI`. No cwd/store. Needs models.json path. Two sub-options:
  - **(B1) Pass cwd into journalMode.** Change signature `journalMode(pi, modelsPath?)`. Callers in lifecycle.ts:306,324,336 pass `path.join(ctx.cwd, ".picode", "models.json")`. Clean.
  - **(B2) Read via spawn.ts `loadModelsJson`.** Already git-root aware. But journal.ts importing spawn.ts creates layering oddity (journal is core, spawn is tools). 
  - Recommend B1 — explicit, testable, no cross-layer import.
- `journalMode` rewrite:
  ```ts
  export function journalMode(pi: ExtensionAPI, modelsPath?: string): "turn"|"done"|"off" {
    const v = pi.getFlag("picode-journal");
    if (v === "done" || v === "off") return v;
    if (modelsPath) {
      try {
        const cfg = existsSync(modelsPath) ? JSON.parse(readFileSync(modelsPath,"utf8")) : {};
        const c = cfg["journal-cadence"];
        if (c === "done" || c === "off") return c;
      } catch {}
    }
    return "turn";
  }
  ```
- Selector UI for cadence: add special entry in `buildRoleItems` after "(reset all)":
  ```ts
  items.push({value:"\x00cadence", label:"(journal cadence)", description: config["journal-cadence"] ?? "turn (default)"});
  ```
  Selecting it → 3-item sub-list: turn / done / off. Write to `config["journal-cadence"]`. Add `"journal-cadence"` to NON_ROLE_KEYS so reset-all preserves it? **No** — reset should clear cadence too (back to default "turn"). Keep it OUT of NON_ROLE_KEYS. But then `buildRoleItems` line 76 `addRole` loop will ALSO show it as a regular role entry → duplicate. Fix: skip keys starting with `"journal-"` in the custom-key loop, OR add to a separate `META_KEYS` set that's skipped in addRole but handled explicitly. Recommend: add `journal-cadence` to NON_ROLE_KEYS (preserves on reset-all — arguable) OR filter in addRole. Simplest: filter `if (key.startsWith("journal-")) return;` in custom-key loop, handle explicitly.
- **Cadence key naming:** `"journal-cadence"` vs `"journalCadence"`. models.json uses lowercase keys (`default`, `builder`, `theme`). Match style: `"journal-cadence"`. But `theme`/`coordinator` are single words. Hyphen OK — `journal-cadence` parallels `journal` key. Consistent.

## MISSED RISKS (plan didn't catch)

### R1: Compaction fork uses same model — state.ts:364
Plan edge-case #3 mentioned compaction but Change 2 only patched :358. **Must patch :362-365 too** or compaction still inherits dead coordinator model → 402 on compact. Fixed in Change 2 above.

### R2: `loadModelsJson` cache staleness
`spawn.ts:42` caches by mtime. Selector writes models.json via `writeModelsConfig` (fs.writeFileSync, no mtime notify). Next `loadModelsJson` call re-stats mtime → picks up change. OK. But within SAME turn as a `/picode-models` write, if forkJournal fires at turn_end, mtime check catches it. Safe.

### R3: Auto-created default models.json (state.ts:172-184)
Coordinator auto-creates models.json with builder/reviewer/etc but NO `journal` key. After change, that's fine — absent key = inherit. But consider adding `"journal": "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"` to defaults so fresh installs get cheap journaling out of box? **Recommend YES** — prevents the exact 402 scenario that motivated this. Add to `defaultModels` object at state.ts:175.

### R4: journalMode called 3x per agent_end (lifecycle.ts:324,336)
Each call now does fs.readFileSync. 3 reads of small file — negligible. But could pass mode into a local var. Minor, optional.

### R5: `--picode-journal` CLI flag still wins over models.json
Correct per plan (backward compat). But means a coordinator launched with `--picode-journal turn` ignores models.json cadence. Document in flag description (index.ts:31-33): "overrides models.json journal-cadence". Minor.

### R6: Multiple coordinators sharing models.json
models.json is per-project (git root). Two coordinators in same repo share it. Setting journal model/cadence affects both. Probably desired (shared config). No issue — just note.

## Answers to your questions
1. **journal alongside roles — correct.** It's per-project config, same file, same selector. Separate config = more files, more paths, more drift. models.json already holds non-role `theme`/`coordinator`. `journal` fits.
2. **3b (selector UI).** 3a not persistent — user re-passes flag every session, defeats purpose.
3. **Missed: R1 (compaction :364), R3 (default models.json), R4 (triple read).** Compaction is real bug risk — same 402.
4. **Error message — yes, improve.** `journal.ts:222` currently dumps `errOut.slice(0,300)`. 402/no-balance buried in stderr noise. Add detection:
   ```ts
   const balanceErr = /402|Insufficient Balance|insufficient_balance|no balance/i.test(errOut);
   const msg = balanceErr
     ? `[picode] journal fork failed: model balance/quota error (exit ${code}). Set a cheaper journal model via /picode-models. stderr: ${errOut.trim().slice(0,200)}`
     : `[picode] journal fork produced no entry (exit ${code})${errOut.trim() ? `: ${errOut.trim().slice(0,300)}` : ""}`;
   console.error(msg);
   ```
   Apply same to compaction fork error (journal.ts:~255, the `proc.on("close")` in compactJournal).
5. **Simpler architecture? No.** Plan is minimal. Only simplification: export `loadModelsJson` (Change 2-A) avoids duplicate path logic. Don't build separate config system.

## File:line change summary
| File | Lines | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `src/commands-models.ts:22` | ROLE_DISPLAY_ORDER | Add `"journal"` after `"default"` |
| `src/commands-models.ts:76` | addRole | Special-case journal unset → "(inherits coordinator model)" |
| `src/commands-models.ts:~235` | buildRoleItems | Add `(journal cadence)` entry; filter `journal-*` from custom-key loop |
| `src/commands-models.ts` interactive loop | | Handle `\x00cadence` sentinel → 3-item sub-list |
| `src/state.ts:357-359` | forkJournal | CLI flag → loadModelsJson()["journal"] → undefined |
| `src/state.ts:362-365` | compactJournal | Same |
| `src/tools/spawn.ts:38` | loadModelsJson | Add `export` |
| `src/journal.ts:78-81` | journalMode | Add modelsPath param, read journal-cadence fallback |
| `src/lifecycle.ts:306,324,336` | journalMode callers | Pass modelsPath |
| `src/state.ts:175` | defaultModels | Add `"journal": "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash"` |
| `src/journal.ts:222` | forkJournalEntry error | Detect 402/balance, actionable message |
| `src/journal.ts:~255` | compactJournal error | Same |
| `src/index.ts:31-33` | flag description | Note "overrides models.json" |

Test coverage: unit tests for `journalMode` with modelsPath, `buildRoleItems` with journal entry, `resolveModel` ignoring journal key (already passes). No E2E needed — deterministic.

Ready to implement on your go.
